'''Palob Godalhi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the son of decorated constable [[Janu Godalhi/Legends|Janu Godalhi]] and played a major role in the [[Teth/Legends|Tethan]] resistance against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
[[File:Palob_Godalhi_mini_game.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Godalhi piloting the ''Moldy Crow'']]
Palob Godalhi was the chief aide to [[Winfrid Dagore]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> He came into possession of the ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'' when Dagore was captured by [[IG-72/Legends|IG-72]] and [[Dace Bonearm]]; though he later landed it in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] ship ''[[New Hope]]'', giving it to the Alliance for their missions. From there, the ship was requisitioned by [[Kyle Katarn]].<ref name="DFS">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407b|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 2: Unsung Heroes of the Light}}</ref>

After the fall of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Palob together with his father wrote several history books about the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Palob Godalhi's name is an anagram of [[Pablo Hidalgo]].
